listings.description: Welcome home to an incredible opportunity in the heart of Leesburg-a single-family home priced below many townhomes and below the current assessed value! This move-in-ready home offers the perfect chance to settle in now and add your own personal touches over time. The property is situated on a beautiful, level lot measuring just under one-third of an acre, providing plenty of space to relax, entertain, garden, or play. Tucked away in a quiet neighborhood, the home is just a short walk from the W&OD Trail and vibrant downtown Leesburg, where you can enjoy an outstanding selection of shops, restaurants, breweries, and local events. Loudoun County's renowned wineries and breweries are also just a short drive away. Convenient access to Route 7, Route 15, and the Dulles Greenway makes commuting and traveling throughout Northern Virginia easy. A single-family home at this price is a rare find. Do not miss this amazing opportunity!

Welcome to this beautiful and well-maintained home in the sought-after the Lakes at Red Rock neighborhood! Approximately 3,301 finished square feet with 4 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms and 2 car garage. Located on a premium cul-de-sac lot. Updated kitchen with white quartz countertops, slate blue cabinets and stainless-steel appliances. Updated bathrooms with new light fixtures and faucets. Gleaming solid oak hardwood floors throughout main level and upper level. Fully finished walk-up basement with large game room, home office, full bathroom and storage room. Large partially fenced and level backyard. Updates include; Smoke Detectors 2026, Dishwasher 2026, Range Hood 2026, Refrigerator 2025, Stove 2025, Roof 2025, Dryer 2025, Driveway 2024, HVAC 2018, Water Heater 2016. Professionally painted from top to bottom and ready for new owners. Just minutes from Leesburg Premium Outlets and Historic Downtown Leesburg.

Welcome to this beautifully maintained brick-front single-family home in sought-after Lansdowne on the Potomac! Situated on a desirable corner lot, this impressive three-level home offers over 3,700 square feet of finished living space, featuring 4 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, and an attached 2-car garage. A dramatic two-story foyer welcomes you inside, where hardwood flooring extends throughout the entire main level. The spacious living and dining areas are filled with natural light, creating an inviting atmosphere for everyday living and entertaining. The large family room features a cozy gas fireplace and windows that bring the outdoors in. The gourmet kitchen has been thoughtfully updated with newer stainless steel appliances, including a wall oven (2025), microwave (2025), downdraft cooktop (2025), dishwasher (2025), and a Wi-Fi-enabled refrigerator (2024). You'll also appreciate the 42-inch cabinetry enhanced with stylish new hardware. The main level also features a convenient dedicated laundry room Adjacent to the kitchen, the sunroom offers a ceiling fan and a wall of windows that flood the space with natural light. Step outside to the deck overlooking a private backyard and serene tree-lined setting, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. . Upstairs, you'll find newer hardwood flooring (2024) throughout the hallway and hardwood in all four bedrooms. The spacious primary suite and generously sized secondary bedrooms provide comfortable accommodations for family and guests. Recent updates include a new roof (2025), new gutters (2025), stainless steel kitchen appliances (2025), HVAC system (2023), washer and dryer (2024), and fresh interior paint (2025). The fully finished walk-out lower level offers a large recreation room with new recessed lighting, a full bathroom, and direct access to the private backyard, providing excellent additional entertaining space. Ideally located in the highly desirable Lansdowne on the Potomac community, residents enjoy easy access to Route 7, Route 15, Lansdowne Town Center shopping and dining, Leesburg Premium Outlets, INOVA Loudoun Hospital, Costco, Grocery stores, and everyday conveniences. The community is also served by the Lansdowne on the Potomac HOA. This is a wonderful opportunity to own a move-in ready home in one of Loudoun County's most desirable communities.

The best thing about this house? The view from the deck off the kitchen! The entire back of the house looks out over a sloping yard to a 134-acre Loudoun County-owned passive park (in conservation easement). Charming colonial with great floor plan! Fresh paint, hardwood floors on the main level, brand-new carpets upstairs, semi-finished walkout basement. Roof replaced in 2018; windows replaced in 2017. Bathrooms have also been updated. This Leesburg Country Club Neighborhood home is ready for you to move in and enjoy right away! Enjoy nature from your own backyard or take a stroll through the park. A great place to walk the dogs! NO HOA! Yet because you'll be within the Town of Leesburg, trash, road maintenance, snow removal, and yard waste (including leaves in the fall) are all included in your taxes, so no added cost to Leesburg residents. Fantastic location: 5-minute drive to the wonderful restaurants in the historic district. Shopping at Compass Creek, Village at Leesburg, the Outlet Mall, and much more are all less than a 10-minute drive! A commuter's dream: super easy access to Route 7, the Dulles Greenway, Routes 7 and 15, and of course, Dulles Airport. OPEN HOUSE SATURDAY, AUG 8, 12-3:00

Welcome to 306 Lounsbury Ct NE - a beautifully updated split-level home in the heart of historic Leesburg offering NO HOA and fully paid-off solar panels for exceptional long-term value. More than just move-in ready, this home offers a rare combination of comfort, efficiency, and smart homeownership. While many homeowners experienced rising utility costs this winter, the current owners enjoyed electric bills averaging approximately just $10/month thanks to the owned solar panel system. It's a valuable advantage in today's market, providing meaningful monthly savings and protection against increasing energy costs - without the added expense of a solar loan or lease. Inside, the home features a comfortable and functional layout with four bedrooms and two full bathrooms upstairs, including a spacious primary suite with dual closets for practical storage. Natural light fills the home throughout the day, while the skylight creates a warm and inviting ambiance in the evening. The main level is designed for both everyday living and entertaining. The spacious kitchen opens to the family room, where a cozy fireplace and built-in entertainment center create a welcoming gathering space. French glass doors offer flexibility and privacy when desired, while sliding doors lead directly to the backyard for easy indoor-outdoor living. A formal dining room and an additional living area provide plenty of space to host guests, relax, or work comfortably from home. Recent updates include fresh paint throughout, brand-new carpet, updated lighting, refreshed bathrooms, and a clean, modern feel from top to bottom. Additional highlights include a two-car garage, spacious backyard, and an unbeatable location just a few blocks away from Downtown Leesburg, where you can enjoy local shops, restaurants, community events, and historic attractions while still benefiting from a quiet residential setting. The home is also located just one mile from Ida Lee Park, Leesburg's renowned 138-acre recreation destination featuring indoor and outdoor pools, sports fields, walking trails, playgrounds, and a full recreation center. With an improved price, energy-saving features, and a highly desirable location, this is an opportunity you do not want to miss. (Virtually Staged)

GREAT NEW PRICE**** LENDER INCENTIVES IF USED! MOTIVATED SELLER! Beautifully reimagined with timeless finishes and thoughtful updates throughout, this exceptional residence offers the ease of one-level living paired with the flexibility of expansive interior space-all set on a generous corner lot in a quiet, established neighborhood with no HOA. Designed with both everyday comfort and effortless entertaining in mind, the home features three spacious bedrooms and three full baths, complemented by rich hardwood flooring throughout the main level, fresh designer-inspired paint, and new carpeting in every bedroom. Custom closet systems enhance each bedroom, providing exceptional organization and storage, while the home's accessible design includes the potential for handicap-friendly living with a roll-in shower. At the heart of the home, the renovated kitchen combines style and functionality with abundant workspace, a new microwave, and an inviting layout that flows seamlessly into the main living areas, creating an ideal setting for gathering with family and friends. Outdoor living is equally inviting. A newly constructed Trex deck overlooks the freshly landscaped yard, offering the perfect backdrop for morning coffee, evening relaxation, or outdoor entertaining. Significant recent improvements provide lasting value and peace of mind, including a new HVAC system (August 2025), gutter guards, and an oversized two-car garage with extra depth for storage, hobbies, or workshop space. The fully finished lower level dramatically expands the home's versatility, featuring a private exterior entrance and space well suited for a guest suite, multigenerational living, a home office, fitness studio, or recreation room. With the potential for an additional bedroom, the lower level offers exceptional flexibility to accommodate your evolving lifestyle. Ideally located just minutes from shopping, dining, parks, scenic walking trails, schools, and major commuter routes, this move-in-ready home offers the rare combination of sophisticated updates, functional design, and an established setting-creating an exceptional opportunity for those seeking both comfort and convenience.

listings.address: 606 Edwards Ferry Rd NE, Leesburg, VA, 20176
listings.description: Tucked into an ideal in-town Leesburg location, this charming property offers the rare combination of convenience, privacy, and freedom with no HOA. Imagine starting your mornings on the long, welcoming front porch, surrounded by the beauty of the shaded front yard, or unwinding there in the evening as the neighborhood settles into a peaceful rhythm. Inside, the spacious layout is designed for both everyday comfort and effortless entertaining, with an oversized kitchen that serves as the heart of the home and a generously sized living room where family and friends can gather with ease. Outside, the detached two-car garage provides exceptional flexibility for hobbyists, car enthusiasts, or those in need of workshop space, while ample parking ensures plenty of room for guests. Just moments from the shops, restaurants, events, and historic charm of downtown Leesburg, this home offers the perfect balance of accessibility, character, and the privacy that's increasingly hard to find.

Tucked away on a peaceful cul-de-sac in The Lakes and Red Rocks and backing to a serene wooded setting, this beautifully updated colonial offers the perfect balance of timeless elegance, modern comfort, and exceptional privacy. Thoughtfully improved over the years and meticulously maintained, this four-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence is designed for both refined everyday living and effortless entertaining. A welcoming foyer introduces the home's warm, sophisticated interior, where rich Brazilian Tigerwood hardwood flooring extends throughout the foyer, formal living room, dining room, staircase, and upper hallway, creating a seamless sense of style and craftsmanship. The traditional floor plan offers gracious formal spaces complemented by an inviting family room anchored by a dramatic floor-to-ceiling stone gas fireplace-an ideal gathering place for quiet evenings or lively celebrations. At the heart of the home, the thoughtfully updated kitchen blends beauty and functionality with Brazilian granite countertops, porcelain tile flooring, stainless steel Samsung appliances, and a sun-filled breakfast area overlooking the tranquil backyard. Whether hosting holiday dinners or enjoying a casual morning coffee, this space is designed to bring people together. Upstairs, four generously proportioned bedrooms provide comfortable accommodations, including a spacious primary suite that serves as a private retreat. The finished lower level expands the home's versatility with a recreation room perfect for movie nights, fitness, gaming, or hobbies, while an unfinished area with plumbing rough-in offers outstanding potential for future customization which could include an additional room, bathroom, and ample storage space. Outside, the private backyard is framed by mature trees and backs up to Red Rock Wilderness Overlook Regional Park, creating a peaceful natural backdrop for everyday living. A beautifully crafted stone patio with illuminated pillars provides an elegant outdoor setting for al fresco dining, entertaining under the stars, or simply unwinding in the quiet surroundings. Beyond the home's impressive aesthetics, buyers will appreciate the extensive list of significant updates that provide both confidence and long-term value, including a brand-new roof (2026), HVAC system (2019), water heater (2023), Brazilian granite countertops, Brazilian Tigerwood flooring, updated garage doors and openers, and a full suite of Samsung stainless steel kitchen appliances. Residents enjoy access to outstanding community amenities, including a generously sized pool with clubhouse, tennis courts, scenic walking trails, a community pond, playgrounds, a dog park, beautifully maintained common areas, plus snow removal and trash service-all contributing to an exceptional lifestyle. Ideally located to historic downtown Leesburg, premier shopping and dining, wineries, breweries, parks, and major commuter routes, this exceptional residence offers the rare opportunity to enjoy timeless design, quality updates, and a picturesque setting in one of Loudoun County's most desirable communities.

JUST REDUCED! Bring your BEST OFFER! Great opportunity to own a wonderful home in a great location at a price at least $70K below market, move in ready and waiting for a new owner to update. Solidly built all brick home on a quarter acre corner lot, in an established community with no HOA and where homes are rarely for sale. Located in the heart of downtown Leesburg within walking distance to the historic district with local shops, dining, community events, as well as the Ida Lee Park Recreation Center and Rust Library, and easy access to numerous commuter routes. The welcoming front porch invites you into a spacious, freshly painted home with gorgeous hardwood floors flowing throughout the main level with 3 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms. The living room has a huge picture window for natural light and built-in shelves surrounding the gas fireplace with glass doors. The dining room, also with a huge picture window, includes chair molding, built-in cabinets and a ceiling fan. The kitchen, with new LVP flooring, includes double sinks, side by side fridge with ice/water dispenser, built in microwave, dishwasher and stove with preferred gas cooking. On the same level, the home boasts 3 generously sized bedrooms, all with cedar lined closets and ceiling fans, with an en-suite bathroom for the primary bedroom. The lower level has a huge family room with a cozy wood burning fireplace and brand new carpeting, plus 2 bonus rooms with lots of potential to use as you see fit, with an abundance of storage room, a half bath, and also a utility sink. Outside you'll find a tastefully landscaped yard and plenty of parking for your family and friends, with the driveway desending behind the home with a lower level parking area and garage. Home has been updated with a new HVAC installed in 2022, providing central heat and AC. The detached outdoor shed has an exterior charging station for your car or RV. Don't miss this opportunity to own a great home in one of Leesburg's most desirable locations.

Come home to a place that instantly calms your mind with its expansive serene backyard views. This one of a kind lot will not disappoint with open views and perfect walking distance to downtown Leesburg and Ida Lee Rec Center. This stunning renovated Colonial home in the desirable Exeter community boasts three levels of excellent living space, featuring 4 spacious bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms. This home offers the flexibility of two family room spaces. After a long day at work, gather in your main floor family room for some laid-back conversation to help unwind from the day. A cathedral ceiling and a cozy fireplace are the focal points of this room. Once dinner is complete, you can enjoy a movie in your lower-level rec room with its expansive TV wall and a bar, plus a kitchen-like area to make snacks. Or if you prefer, there is plenty of room for exercise equipment. Then the six-person jacuzzi right outside could be the perfect way to end your day! The gourmet kitchen, complete with a pantry, new quartz countertops and updated appliances, flows seamlessly into the family room, perfect for entertaining. Enjoy brand new luxury laminate plank and ceramic tile flooring throughout, along with energy-efficient windows and a cozy wood fireplace. Recent renovations in 2024-2025 enhance the property's appeal, while the fully finished daylight basement offers additional living space with custom wood bar, and kitchenette. All major updates include windows(2021), roof(2013), HVAC(2020), siding(2021) and egress window(2026), This outdoor space includes a deck, hot tub, and enclosed storage all set against a backdrop of endless open space views. Community amenities include a pool, basketball courts, and playgrounds, fostering a vibrant neighborhood atmosphere. Conveniently located within walking distance to schools, parks, and beautiful downtown Leesburg , this home offers both comfort and community engagement. With ample parking and a well-maintained yard, this property is a perfect blend of style and functionality.

Welcome to 821 Cattail Lane, a one-of-a-kind split-level home featuring a stunning two-story addition in the highly sought-after Exeter community of Leesburg. Offering nearly 2,800 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space across two finished levels. Step inside to find luxury vinyl plank flooring throughout the main level and a beautifully renovated kitchen that serves as the heart of the home. Featuring custom cabinetry, sleek quartz countertops with a designer backsplash, black stainless steel appliances, recessed lighting, abundant storage, and an oversized center island with pendant lighting. The main level also offers a welcoming formal living room with a cozy wood-burning fireplace, an updated powder room, a spacious coat closet, and a dedicated dining area. Just beyond the dining space is the home's true showpiece-a breathtaking two-story great room addition filled with natural light and soaring ceilings, creating an impressive space for relaxing or gathering with family and friends. Upstairs, the private owner's suite features generous closet space and an en-suite bath with a walk-in shower. Two additional spacious bedrooms share the upper level, along with a full hall bathroom. A separate staircase leads to the fourth bedroom, a private en-suite retreat complete with its own full bath and versatile loft/landing area overlooking the great room - ideal for guests, in-laws, multigenerational living, or an older child wanting additional privacy. Outside, enjoy a beautifully landscaped, mostly fenced backyard designed for outdoor living. The expansive two-tier hardscape patio features a grilling station and offers the perfect setting for dining, entertaining, or unwinding. A storage shed provides additional convenience. Recent improvements include the two-story great room and upper-level en-suite addition (2005), complete kitchen renovation (2021), luxury vinyl plank flooring throughout the main level (2021), renovated powder room (2021), replacement windows (2020), new roof (2022), brand-new carpet (2026), and brand-new exterior doors (2026). Located in the desirable Exeter neighborhood, residents enjoy community amenities including an outdoor pool and tennis courts, while being just a short walk to Leesburg Elementary School. The home is zoned for the highly regarded Loudoun County Public Schools, including Leesburg Elementary, Smart's Mill Middle School, and Tuscarora High School. Conveniently situated just minutes from historic downtown Leesburg, shopping, dining, and major commuter routes including Route 15, Route 7, and the Dulles Toll Road, this home offers the perfect combination of comfort, convenience, and location.

listings.address: 306 Morven Park Ct NW, Leesburg, VA, 20176
listings.description: This one has it all! Step inside to an updated gourmet kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and ceramic tile flooring, perfect for everyday living and entertaining alike. A large custom bump-out expands the main living area, adding valuable square footage and flexible living space you won't find in a typical floor plan (plus recently installed split unit HVAC system) Beautiful hardwood floors flow throughout the main and upper levels, complemented by extensive crown molding and two cozy gas fireplaces that add warmth and character to the home. Retreat to updated bathrooms with ceramic tile finishes, and enjoy the convenience of spacious walk-in closets throughout. High-quality windows and sliding doors fill the home with natural light while offering energy efficiency and durability. Step outside to a wraparound Trex deck - the ideal spot for morning coffee or evening relaxation overlooking the backyard. And the showstopper: your very own private pool, transforming the backyard into a personal summer retreat perfect for entertaining, family fun, or simply unwinding after a long day. This home truly checks every box. Don't miss your chance to make it yours!

Step inside to discover bright, sun-filled living spaces enhanced by abundant natural light and window blinds throughout the home, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. A cozy fireplace serves as the centerpiece of the main living area, while the well-appointed kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring high-end appliances, generous counter space, and ample storage for all your culinary needs. The home offers four spacious bedrooms, each providing a peaceful retreat. The luxurious primary suite serves as a private sanctuary, complete with an elegant en-suite bathroom featuring refined finishes and fixtures. With three full bathrooms and an additional half bath, the home is designed with both comfort and convenience in mind. The fully finished walkout basement adds exceptional versatility, offering the perfect space for a media room, fitness area, game room, home office, or guest retreat. Walkout stairs provide seamless access to the backyard, extending your living and entertaining space outdoors. Outside, the beautifully landscaped yard creates a serene setting for relaxing, gathering with friends and family, or enjoying quiet moments surrounded by nature. The attached front-entry two-car garage is equipped with a Tesla charger, providing added convenience for electric vehicle owners. Additional driveway and ample off-street parking ensure plenty of space for guests. Ideally located in a vibrant community with easy access to parks, trails, shopping, dining, and recreational amenities, this exceptional home offers a lifestyle of comfort, sophistication, and connection. Every detail has been thoughtfully curated to create a residence that feels both luxurious and welcoming. Don't miss the opportunity to make this remarkable Edwards Landing home your own.

Welcome to 401 Crestwood Drive, where timeless craftsmanship meets modern luxury in one of Leesburg's most sought-after in-town neighborhoods. This is far more than a renovation; it's a meticulous restoration completed to an exceptional standard. Virtually every major system and finish was thoughtfully replaced, allowing the next owner to enjoy the charm of an established neighborhood with the confidence of a nearly new home. From the moment you arrive, you'll appreciate the attention to detail, beginning with the new architectural shingle roof, all-new James Hardie siding, new energy-efficient windows, and a professionally installed 6-foot privacy fence. Inside, every space has been reimagined with quality, functionality, and style in mind. The home features an entirely new central HVAC system with all-new ductwork, updated plumbing and electrical systems, recessed lighting throughout, a new hot water heater, and an electric vehicle charging station. The heart of the home is a beautifully designed kitchen featuring custom cabinetry with under-cabinet lighting, stunning countertops, and brand-new appliances. Every bathroom has been completely transformed, including a luxurious primary suite with a spa-inspired bath and spacious walk-in closets, a beautifully appointed secondary full bath, and a stylish powder room. New flooring flows seamlessly throughout the home, completing a clean, modern aesthetic that feels both elegant and inviting. The lifestyle offered by this location is equally impressive. Leave the car at home and enjoy a short walk to Historic Downtown Leesburg, where locally owned restaurants, boutique shopping, coffee shops, breweries, wineries, community events, and the award-winning Leesburg Farmers Market create a vibrant small-town atmosphere. Whether you're enjoying First Friday celebrations, weekend brunch, outdoor concerts, or simply strolling the charming historic streets, you'll quickly discover why Leesburg is consistently recognized as one of Northern Virginia's most desirable places to live. Homes of this caliber are rarely available. Combining the character of an established neighborhood with the peace of mind that comes from an extensive, top-to-bottom restoration, 401 Crestwood Drive offers a truly turnkey opportunity where every detail has already been thoughtfully completed.

Nestled in the prestigious Stratford community, this exquisite Colonial-style residence offers a harmonious blend of luxury and comfort, perfect for those seeking an elevated lifestyle. With a generous 3,054 square feet of meticulously designed living space, this home has undergone significant renovations in 2023, ensuring modern elegance throughout. Step inside to discover an inviting open floor plan that seamlessly connects the family room, dining area, and kitchen, creating an ideal space for both entertaining and everyday living. The family room, adorned with built-ins and large windows, invites natural light, while the kitchen boasts ample table space, perfect for casual dining. High-end appliances, including a sleek refrigerator, dishwasher, and stove, make culinary endeavors a delight. The home features four spacious bedrooms, including a luxurious primary suite complete with an en-suite bath, offering a private retreat. Each bathroom is thoughtfully designed, showcasing modern fixtures and finishes that elevate daily routines. The fully finished basement adds versatility, providing additional living space for recreation or relaxation. Exterior highlights include a beautifully landscaped corner lot, enhancing curb appeal and providing a sense of privacy. Enjoy outdoor living on the expansive deck, perfect for summer gatherings or quiet evenings under the stars. The community amenities are equally impressive, featuring a sparkling outdoor pool, jogging paths, and playgrounds, fostering a vibrant neighborhood atmosphere. Additional conveniences include an attached two-car garage with a garage door opener and ample driveway space for guests. The property is strategically located near the airport and within a mile of public transportation, ensuring easy access to the surrounding area. With its combination of high-end features, thoughtful renovations, and a welcoming community, this home is not just a place to live but a lifestyle to embrace. Experience the perfect blend of luxury and comfort in this stunning Stratford residence, where every detail has been curated for your enjoyment.

CHARMING FARMHOUSE ON 20 PRIVATE ACRES WITH BARNS, POND & VIEWS! Nestled at the end of a long private gravel driveway lined with towering pines, this charming two-level Colonial farmhouse is tucked away on a breathtaking 20-acre rural property in the sought-after Chestnut Hill farming community. Offering privacy, tranquility, and endless possibilities for farming, horses, hobbies, or simply enjoying country living, this exceptional property combines comfortable living with ultimate privacy. Recently refreshed with neutral paint throughout and new luxury vinyl plank flooring on the main level, the home features over 2,300 square feet of living space. A welcoming full front porch provides the perfect place to relax and take in the pastoral surroundings, including views of the neighboring historic Chestnut Hill Mansion! Inside, a two-story foyer welcomes you into the home. The main level offers a convenient bedroom and/or office and full bath, a spacious living room, and a large country kitchen that opens seamlessly to both the screened porch and expansive rear deck. The front porch connects to a side porch, creating multiple outdoor spaces to enjoy the peaceful setting and sweeping pasture views in every direction. The upper level features a spacious primary suite with vaulted ceilings, a walk-in closet, and a private bath with separate shower and soaking tub. Two additional bedrooms, a secondary full bath, and an upper-level laundry room provide added convenience. The property is truly a rare rural retreat! A private pond sits beyond the home, while several outbuildings provide incredible flexibility for agricultural, equestrian, storage, workshop, or recreational uses. Highlights include a picturesque bank barn offering 2,280 square feet with unforgettable panoramic farm views, a 2,000-square-foot common stable, and a 1,680-square-foot three-wall storage shed, and two additional storage sheds. With no HOA and abundant open space, the opportunities are endless. Farm, fish, raise animals, cultivate gardens, pursue your hobbies, or simply enjoy the serenity and beauty of Loudoun County's countryside. House and property sold strictly as-is. Ideally located just off James Monroe Highway, the property offers convenient access to major commuter routes while remaining worlds away from the hustle and bustle. Enjoy nearby farmers markets, roadside farm stands, and the charm of Lucketts Village. Historic downtown Leesburg, with its vibrant dining, shopping, and entertainment scene, is just minutes away. Easy access to Maryland makes this an exceptional location for commuters seeking the best of rural living without sacrificing convenience. A rare opportunity to own a private farmstead in one of Loudoun County's most picturesque settings. Property sold in As-Is condition, Seller prefers Entitle First Title in Leesburg.

Discover the perfect blend of modern updates and peaceful surroundings in this beautifully renovated rancher, nestled on a private lot surrounded by mature trees and lush landscaping. Gorgeous hardwood floors flow throughout the main level, where a spacious living room welcomes you with soaring vaulted ceilings, a striking fireplace with built-ins, and a stunning wall of windows that frames picturesque outdoor views. The beautifully updated gourmet kitchen features stainless steel appliances, modern finishes, abundant cabinetry, and generous counter space, creating the perfect space for everyday living and entertaining. Three comfortable bedrooms complete the main level. The fully finished lower level offers exceptional flexibility with a spacious primary suite featuring an updated en suite bath and walk-in closet. A convenient kitchenette and beautiful LVP flooring make this level ideal for guests, multi-generational living, or potential rental opportunities. Outside, enjoy the tranquility of nature from the deck or patio overlooking the private backyard with plenty of room for gardening, outdoor entertaining, and recreation. A large storage shed provides additional space for tools and equipment. The oversized two-car garage offers ample storage, while the extended driveway provides abundant additional parking. The home is serviced by Verizon FiOS internet, providing reliable high-speed connectivity. Move-in ready and thoughtfully updated throughout, this exceptional home also enjoys convenient access to local wineries, offering the perfect balance of privacy and nearby amenities.

OPEN HOUSE, SUNDAY AUG 9th, 11am to 1pm. IMPROVED PRICE! Come see it again for the first time!. You will immediately know you are home upon entering. Enjoy beautiful scraped hardwood flooring throughout the main level, with refinished kitchen cabinets, a new island and granite counters. Newly refinished white cabinets and "agreeable" grey walls perfectly complement each other, and you will thoroughly enjoy the spotless appliances and beautiful view of your fenced yard from the kitchen windows. Enjoy time together with family and friends in the family room off the kitchen, and impress your guests with the freshly painted deck with a newly installed canopy for shade on hot days. The upstairs boasts 4bd/2ba, with the comfort and warmth of newer carpeting. The newly finished downstairs features a nice family room, a partial kitchen, reading/study area, a full bath and a non-conforming 5th bedroom (or den, office, etc). Walkout to the lush and fully fenced backyard, and store your seasonal items in the built-in shed. You will also love the fresh clean look of freshly painted doors and trim, with new stainless hardware on all doors. With a new roof (2019), Trane HVAC, and over-sized gas hot water heater, you're assured many years of carefree living.

Stunning Lockmeade Model in highly sought-after Potomac Crossing, ideally situated at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac on a large, flat, fenced backyard lot. Offering nearly 3,300 square feet on three finished levels, this beautifully updated home features 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, a bright open floor plan, and extensive recent renovations throughout. Formal living and dining rooms with bay windows welcome you inside, while the dramatic family room showcases vaulted ceilings, a custom-built fireplace, recessed LED lighting, and a wall of windows overlooking the backyard. The spacious kitchen features a center island and Bosch stainless steel appliances (2021). Major updates completed in late 2024 include fresh interior and exterior paint, all new flooring and carpet, updated lighting and ceiling fans throughout, new blinds, recessed lighting, dimmer switches, motion-sensor floodlights, renovated laundry room with new washer and dryer, and fully remodeled primary and hall bathrooms. The luxurious primary suite offers dual walk-in closets and a stunning new spa-inspired bath with custom shower, upgraded vanities, and enhanced electrical features. Enjoy outdoor living from the enhanced 3-season sunroom and newly improved deck featuring added lighting, ceiling fan, and entertainment space. Additional improvements include a reverse osmosis water filter and faucet installed in the kitchen, waterline installed in the gym, radon mitigation system, upgraded electrical outlets on the rear exterior, new mailbox, garden installation, and decorative rear rock border. The finished lower level offers a spacious recreation room , media room/guest sleeping area, full bath, dedicated gym space, and abundant storage. Recent mechanical and efficiency upgrades include Roof and HVAC (2019), Water Heater (2017), Family Room Windows (2023), Fence (2023), attic insulation (2026), garage floor insulation (2026), all new upper-level windows plus four additional lower-level windows (2026), and a new dedicated HVAC system serving the main level and basement (2026). Potomac Crossing residents enjoy exceptional community amenities including a pool, playgrounds, walking trails, and convenient access to shopping, dining, commuter routes, and schools.

Welcome home to this stunning beauty in the Tavistock Farms community! This traditional, light filled home offers 5 bedrooms and 3.5 baths. The main level boasts a two story foyer, 9' ceilings, open concept kitchen/dining/living and a home office/den. This level of the home includes a separate, formal dining and living area. The upper level of the home includes a large primary suite with two separate closets and a sitting area. The lower level of the home offers a wet bar and is the perfect hang out room for relaxing and entertaining. Tucked away on a third of an acre on a private cul de sac. Resent updates all done in 2026 Replaced the HVAC system 2026 Freshly paint the entire interior of the house. New carpet throughout the home Updated the living room with a more modern design and aesthetic. Replaced all of the home's toilets with modern fixtures. Updated the vanity in the bedroom bathroom. Replaced and updated the light fixtures throughout the house to create a more modern, cohesive look.

Beautifully updated and move in ready! Main level boasts open space with cozy family room with fireplace and built in shelving, separate dining room, and updated kitchen with stainless appliances and custom island. Kitchen walks out to freshly stained and oversized deck backing to large flat back yard, common space, and trees. This home has a much desired two car garage entering into laundry/mud room. Upper level had three spacious bedrooms with large closets and two updated baths.
